nodes.Name: Options
nodes.DocComment: Options is the common options type shared across json packages.

nodes.Name: Struct
nodes.DocComment:
Struct is the combination of all options in struct form.
This is efficient to pass down the call stack and to query.

nodes.Name: DefaultOptionsV2
nodes.DocComment: DefaultOptionsV2 is the set of all options that define default v2 behavior.

nodes.Name: DefaultOptionsV1
nodes.DocComment: DefaultOptionsV1 is the set of all options that define default v1 behavior.

nodes.Name: GetUnknownOption
nodes.DocComment:
GetUnknownOption is injected by the "json" package to handle Options
declared in that package so that "jsonopts" can handle them.

nodes.Name: JoinUnknownOption
nodes.DocComment:
JoinUnknownOption is injected by the "json" package to handle Options
declared in that package so that "jsonopts" can handle them.
